002423: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CBfloat16Builtin const* c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(String8 name)
002424: {
002425:     CBfloat16Builtin const* result = 0;
002426:     if (string_starts_with_sequence(name, S8("__builtin_ia32_")))
002427:     {
002428:         for (u32 index = 0; index < BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(c_bfloat16_builtins) && !result; index += 1)
002429:         {
002430:             if (string_equal(name, c_bfloat16_builtins[index].name)) result = c_bfloat16_builtins + index;
002431:         }
002432:     }
002433:     return result;
002434: }
002435: 
002436: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_bfloat16_builtin_result(CParseResult* result, CBfloat16Builtin const* builtin)
002437: {
002438:     CBfloat16BuiltinType shape = builtin->types[0];
002439:     CTypeId type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
002440:         .element_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
002441:         .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
002442:         .unqualified_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
002443:         .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
002444:         .kind = shape.kind,
002445:         .is_complete = true,
002446:     });
002447:     if (shape.lanes && type.value < result->type_count)
002448:     {
002449:         type = c_parse_add_type(result, (CType){
002450:             .element_type = type,
002451:             .return_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
002452:             .unqualified_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
002453:             .array_bound = C_ARRAY_BOUND_INVALID,
002454:             .kind = C_TYPE_VECTOR,
002455:             .vector_byte_size = (u32)shape.lanes * (shape.kind == C_TYPE_FLOAT ? 4u : 2u),
002456:             .is_complete = true,
002457:         });
002458:     }
002459:     return type;
002460: }

002462: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL CTypeId c_parse_direct_expression_base(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope,
002463:                                                          u32 base_start, u32 base_end)
002464: {
002465:     CTypeId type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002466:     bool call_base = base_end > base_start + 2 && preprocess.tokens[base_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
002467:                      c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
002468:                      c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
002469:     if ((base_end == base_start + 1 || call_base) && preprocess.tokens[base_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
002470:     {
002471:         CEntityId entity_id = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
002472:         u32 base_use_index = c_parse_identifier_use_index(result, base_start);
002473:         if (base_use_index != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002474:         {
002475:             entity_id = result->identifier_uses[base_use_index].entity;
002476:         }
002477:         CScopeId lookup_scope = scope;
002478:         if (lookup_scope.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->scope_count)
002479:         {
002480:             lookup_scope = (CScopeId){
002481:                 .value = 0,
002482:             };
002483:         }
002484:         if (entity_id.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && lookup_scope.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002485:         {
002486:             entity_id = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, lookup_scope, &preprocess.tokens[base_start]);
002487:         }
002488:         type = entity_id.value < result->entity_count && result->entities[entity_id.value].kind != C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF &&
002489:                        result->entities[entity_id.value].kind != C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR
002490:                    ? result->entities[entity_id.value].type
002491:                    : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002492:         // A call base -- `_PyBaseExceptionObject_cast(self)->context` is what
002493:         // CPython's Py_XSETREF callers hand _Py_TYPEOF -- contributes its
002494:         // return type, through a function pointer's pointee when the name
002495:         // binds to one.
002496:         if (call_base && type.value < result->type_count)
002497:         {
002498:             CType* base_type = &result->types[type.value];
002499:             if (base_type->kind == C_TYPE_POINTER && base_type->element_type.value < result->type_count)
002500:             {
002501:                 base_type = &result->types[base_type->element_type.value];
002502:             }
002503:             type = base_type->kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION ? base_type->return_type : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002504:         }
002505:         else if (call_base && entity_id.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002506:         {
002507:             CBfloat16Builtin const* builtin = c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[base_start]));
002508:             if (builtin)
002509:             {
002510:                 c_parse_position_index_append(result->arena, &result->bfloat16_builtin_calls, &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_count,
002511:                                                &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_capacity, base_start);
002512:                 type = c_parse_bfloat16_builtin_result(result, builtin);
002513:             }
002514:         }
002515:     }
002516:     else if (base_start < base_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
002517:     {
002518:         // A cast base: `((propertyobject *) new)->prop_name` is what
002519:         // Py_SETREF writes through _Py_TYPEOF, so `__typeof__` over it must
002520:         // resolve or the declaration it types declares nothing.  The cast's
002521:         // own type is the whole answer -- the operand after it only carries
002522:         // the value -- and the machineless resolvers exist exactly for walks
002523:         // like this one that may run inside a machine step.
002524:         u32 cast_close = c_parse_matching_delimiter_indexed(result, preprocess, base_start);
002525:         if (cast_close < base_end && cast_close + 1 < base_end)
002526:         {
002527:             u32 type_index = base_start + 1;
002528:             CTypeId cast_type = c_parse_machineless_base_type(result, preprocess, scope, base_start + 1, cast_close, &type_index);
002529:             if (cast_type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002530:             {
002531:                 cast_type = c_parse_pointer_chain(result, preprocess, cast_type, &type_index, cast_close);
002532:                 if (type_index == cast_close)
002533:                 {
002534:                     type = cast_type;
002535:                 }
002536:             }
002537:         }
002538:     }
002539:     return type;
002540: }

002542: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL CTypeId c_parse_direct_expression_postfix(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result,
002543:                                                             CTypeId type, u32 start, u32 end)
002544: {
002545:     u32 index = start;
002546:     while (index < end && type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002547:     {
002548:         if (type.value >= result->type_count)
002549:         {
002550:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002551:             break;
002552:         }
002553:         CType* type_value = &result->types[type.value];
002554:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
002555:         {
002556:             u32 close = c_parse_matching_delimiter_indexed(result, preprocess, index);
002557:             if (close >= end || (type_value->kind != C_TYPE_ARRAY && type_value->kind != C_TYPE_POINTER))
002558:             {
002559:                 type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002560:                 break;
002561:             }
002562:             type = type_value->element_type;
002563:             index = close + 1;
002564:             continue;
002565:         }
002566:         bool indirect = c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW);
002567:         if (!indirect && !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT))
002568:         {
002569:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002570:             break;
002571:         }
002572:         if (indirect)
002573:         {
002574:             if (type_value->kind != C_TYPE_POINTER || type_value->element_type.value >= result->type_count)
002575:             {
002576:                 type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002577:                 break;
002578:             }
002579:             type = type_value->element_type;
002580:             type_value = &result->types[type.value];
002581:         }
002582:         if (index + 1 >= end || preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ||
002583:             (type_value->kind != C_TYPE_STRUCT && type_value->kind != C_TYPE_UNION))
002584:         {
002585:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002586:             break;
002587:         }
002588:         CTypeId field_type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002589:         TemporalArena field_search = arena_begin_temporal(arena);
002590:         CTypeId* work = arena_allocate(field_search.arena, CTypeId, result->type_count + 1);
002591:         bool* visited = arena_allocate(field_search.arena, bool, result->type_count + 1);
002592:         memset(visited, 0, sizeof(*visited) * (result->type_count + 1));
002593:         u32 work_index = 0;
002594:         u32 work_count = 1;
002595:         work[0] = type;
002596:         visited[type.value] = true;
002597:         while (work_index < work_count && field_type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002598:         {
002599:             CTypeId candidate_id = work[work_index++];
002600:             CType* candidate = &result->types[candidate_id.value];
002601:             for (u32 field_index = 0; field_index < candidate->member_count; field_index += 1)
002602:             {
002603:                 CMember* member = &result->members[candidate->member_start + field_index];
002604:                 if (string_equal(member->name, c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index + 1])))
002605:                 {
002606:                     field_type = member->type;
002607:                     break;
002608:                 }
002609:                 if (member->name.length || member->type.value >= result->type_count || visited[member->type.value])
002610:                 {
002611:                     continue;
002612:                 }
002613:                 CType* nested = &result->types[member->type.value];
002614:                 if (nested->kind != C_TYPE_STRUCT && nested->kind != C_TYPE_UNION)
002615:                 {
002616:                     continue;
002617:                 }
002618:                 visited[member->type.value] = true;
002619:                 work[work_count++] = member->type;
002620:             }
002621:         }
002622:         if (field_type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
002623:         {
002624:             scratch_end(field_search);
002625:             type = C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002626:             break;
002627:         }
002628:         type = field_type;
002629:         scratch_end(field_search);
002630:         index += 2;
002631:     }
002632:     return type;
002633: }

002635: // Each continuation owns disjoint prefix and postfix slices. Descending only
002636: // narrows the unresolved base; indexed delimiter matches skip nested ranges.
002637: // Scratch belongs to this query, while every newly constructed CType remains
002638: // in result->arena. No suffix-sized allocation survives a nested descent.
002639: typedef struct CParseDirectExpressionFrame CParseDirectExpressionFrame;
002640: struct CParseDirectExpressionFrame
002641: {
002642:     u32 postfix;
002643:     u32 end;
002644:     u32 prefix_mark;
002645:     u32 prefix_end;
002646:     bool comma;
002647: };

002649: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool c_parse_direct_expression_type_core(Arena* scratch, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope,
